content:
Use the python tool to read this CSV and create a PNG line chart.
Requirements:
- Plot monthly average temperature (Jan-Dec only; ignore Annual Mean)
- Include x/y axes and month labels
- Read the CSV, create the chart, and save it in a single Python execution; do not make preliminary inspection calls
- Save exactly one PNG file named monthly_temperatures.png and close the figure with plt.close()
- Do not display the figure inline
- In your final response, state the saved filename and include exactly one download link to the saved PNG

CSV:
Month,Average Temperature (°C),Deviation from 1991-2020 Norm (°C)
January,0.0,+1.5
February,1.3,+1.7
March,4.1,+1.5
April,8.2,+1.9
May,10.3,-0.2
June,17.6,+3.8
July,15.4,-0.3
August,16.4,+1.2
September,11.9,+0.5
October,7.2,-0.2
November,2.3,+0.1
December,1.3,+2.0
Annual Mean,8.0,+1.1

input.code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from io import StringIO

csv_text = """Month,Average Temperature (°C),Deviation from 1991-2020 Norm (°C)
January,0.0,+1.5
February,1.3,+1.7
March,4.1,+1.5
April,8.2,+1.9
May,10.3,-0.2
June,17.6,+3.8
July,15.4,-0.3
August,16.4,+1.2
September,11.9,+0.5
October,7.2,-0.2
November,2.3,+0.1
December,1.3,+2.0
Annual Mean,8.0,+1.1
"""
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(csv_text))
df = df[df['Month'].isin(['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'])]
months_map = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
df['Month'] = pd.Categorical(df['Month'], categories=months_map, ordered=True)
df = df.sort_values('Month')
x = df['Month'].astype(str)
y = df['Average Temperature (°C)']
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
plt.plot(x, y, marker='o', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Average Temperature (°C)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
out_path='/mnt/data/monthly_temperatures.png'
plt.savefig(out_path, dpi=200)
plt.close()
out_path
